description: This PHP source file generates a report for test cases that have not been executed on any platform within the TestLink testing framework. It initializes the page, fetches data about test plans, projects, and results, then constructs an HTML or Ext-JS table to display test cases that haven't been run across available platforms. It also prepares email configurations and handles rendering the report.
